description: This file defines a repository class for interacting with a database (via Supabase/PostgREST) related to food ordering, including CRUD operations on menu items, cart items, orders, and order items.

classes.name: SupabaseRepository
classes.description: A repository class encapsulating methods to interact with Supabase tables related to food ordering.

methods.name: bool _maybe_schema_error(exc: Exception)
methods.description: Heuristically detects specific database schema or relation errors based on exception messages.

methods.name: list[dict[str,Any]] list_menu_items(self)
methods.description: Returns a list of menu items ordered by name from the `menu_items` table.

methods.name: dict[str,Any]|None get_menu_item(self, menu_item_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a single menu item by its ID.

methods.name: list[dict[str,Any]] list_cart_items(self, user_id: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of cart items for a specific user.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] upsert_cart_item(self, user_id: str, menu_item_id: str, quantity: int)
methods.description: Inserts a new cart item or updates an existing one for a user and menu item.

methods.name: dict[str,Any]|None update_cart_item_quantity(self, user_id: str, item_id: str, quantity: int)
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specific cart item, ensuring it belongs to the user.

methods.name: bool delete_cart_item(self, user_id: str, item_id: str)
methods.description: Deletes a cart item belonging to a user.

methods.name: None clear_cart(self, user_id: str)
methods.description: Removes all cart items for a specified user.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] create_order(self, user_id: str, status: str = "created")
methods.description: Creates a new order record for a user.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] insert_order_item( self, order_id: str, menu_item_id: str, quantity: int, unit_price: float, name: str | None = None, )
methods.description: Inserts a line item into an order.

methods.name: list[dict[str,Any]] list_orders(self, user_id: str)
methods.description: Lists all orders for a user, ordered by creation date.

methods.name: dict[str,Any]|None get_order(self, user_id: str, order_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a specific order by ID for a user.

methods.name: list[dict[str,Any]] list_order_items(self, order_id: str)
methods.description: Lists all items within a specific order.
